scheduling_policy.dependency_rule: A task may enter ready/in_progress only after every depends_on task is done, except the single declared initial_ready_task.
scheduling_policy.concurrency_rule: Tasks with satisfied dependencies may run concurrently when they do not change the same canonical authority contract.
scheduling_policy.promotion_rule: done means implementation plus task acceptance evidence; maturity promotion remains a separate signed accountability action.

tasks.title: Canonical evidence identity
tasks.objective: Define one receipt identity binding git head, config digest, environment, test/verifier identity, timestamps and evidence digest.
acceptance: Exact-head evidence from independent gates can be joined deterministically without filename or log scraping.

tasks.title: Maturity reconciliation engine
tasks.objective: Compare masterplan volume claims against implementation paths, tests, evidence and accountability; emit promotion candidates without self-signing them.
acceptance: Candidate promotions are explainable, reversible and cannot mutate signed maturity state.

tasks.title: Required-gate authority map
tasks.objective: Define which gates are required for which promotion classes and fail closed on missing, skipped, cancelled or stale evidence.
acceptance: A promotion receipt cannot be valid when any required gate is absent, stale or non-success.

tasks.title: Risk/gap evidence binding
tasks.objective: Bind critical/high risks and gaps to executable evidence, owner, expiry/review cadence and accepted-risk disposition.
acceptance: Every blocking P1 risk has executable evidence or a signed, time-bounded accepted-risk record.

tasks.title: Reproducibility bundle
tasks.objective: Package exact inputs, environment, budgets, tests/evals and receipts needed to reproduce qualifying evidence.
acceptance: Independent rerun can reproduce the maturity evidence or explain deterministic incompatibility.

tasks.title: Scope-freeze and ADR enforcement
tasks.objective: Enforce VOL-420 breadth freeze and require a machine-linked ADR for any top-level scope exception.
acceptance: Unapproved new top-level volume or scope bypass fails validation.

tasks.title: API schema and compatibility registry
tasks.objective: Inventory externally visible API contracts, versions, producers/consumers and migration/compatibility rules.
acceptance: Breaking API drift is detected before release promotion.

tasks.title: Streaming projection authority
tasks.objective: Bind cursor/replay/resync and client projection state to durable operation/event authority.
acceptance: Refresh, reconnect, duplicate and out-of-order delivery reconstruct the same durable truth.

tasks.title: Workspace and product projection contract
tasks.objective: Define product/workspace projection records for progress, blockers, cost, evidence and terminal results.
acceptance: UI projections cannot invent or overwrite canonical operation state.

tasks.title: Pause/resume/cancel and human override
tasks.objective: Materialize interruptibility, pause/resume and human override semantics with durable receipts.
acceptance: Control actions survive reconnect/restart and preserve terminal finality.

tasks.title: Web/desktop tenant and storage boundary
tasks.objective: Propagate tenant identity, permission and storage classification through desktop/web/API/stream boundaries.
acceptance: Cross-tenant, local-storage and permission boundary regressions are executable tests.

tasks.title: Experiment registry
tasks.objective: Define experiment identity, hypotheses, traffic/data eligibility, environment, budgets, metrics and lineage.
acceptance: Experiment results are reproducible and cannot silently change production authority.

tasks.title: Benchmark registry and contamination controls
tasks.objective: Version benchmark datasets, splits, contamination status, metric policy and environment.
acceptance: Improvement claims fail when benchmark lineage or contamination state is missing.

tasks.title: Candidate and champion/challenger registry
tasks.objective: Standardize candidate artifacts and incumbent/challenger comparison state with immutable promotion history.
acceptance: Candidate cannot overwrite champion and every promotion has comparative evidence.

tasks.title: Shadow traffic isolation
tasks.objective: Mirror eligible traffic to candidates with redaction, side-effect suppression and paired-comparison metadata.
acceptance: Shadow execution cannot affect authoritative user outcomes or widen privacy boundaries.

tasks.title: Specification and reasoning regression corpus
tasks.objective: Turn adversarial/specification-gaming and reasoning failures into versioned promotion-blocking regressions.
acceptance: Known failure classes block promotion when they regress.

tasks.title: Failure knowledge pipeline
tasks.objective: Ingest incidents, failed experiments, rejected designs and counterexamples into structured failure knowledge linked to risks/tests.
acceptance: Repeated failures are traceable to regression coverage or explicit non-applicability.

tasks.title: Release evidence bundle
tasks.objective: Bind release artifacts, config, SBOM/provenance, tests/evals, installer metadata and rollback evidence to one digest.
acceptance: Release candidate is reconstructable from its evidence bundle.

tasks.title: Installer/update/repair lifecycle
tasks.objective: Prove clean install, interrupted update, repair, uninstall and residual ownership semantics.
acceptance: Lifecycle operations are idempotent/recoverable and leave no unowned critical state.

tasks.title: Migration and rollback compatibility
tasks.objective: Bind schema/config migrations to declared rollback windows and backward-read compatibility.
acceptance: Rollback can read state created by upgraded versions within the declared compatibility window.

tasks.title: Backup and restore qualification
tasks.objective: Define backup coverage, restore dependency order and derived-state rebuild semantics; execute restore drills.
acceptance: Authoritative state restores without semantic loss and derived projections rebuild deterministically.

tasks.title: Disaster recovery and incident feedback
tasks.objective: Exercise disaster scenarios and route incident/postmortem actions into risk/gap/failure ledgers.
acceptance: DR evidence includes RTO/RPO behavior and every corrective action has accountable follow-up.

tasks.title: Attribution and release notices
tasks.objective: Generate release attribution and notices from provenance/license lineage.
acceptance: Release notices are traceable to exact contributing versions and obligations.

tasks.title: Remote execution and worker trust
tasks.objective: Define remote execution envelope, worker identity, attestation, leases and fencing.
acceptance: Unattested or stale workers cannot commit authoritative effects.

tasks.title: Topology-aware model placement and warming
tasks.objective: Bind model placement/warming decisions to compute/network topology, readiness and data-boundary constraints.
acceptance: Placement is reproducible and respects hard resource/security constraints.

tasks.title: Batching and autoscaling controller
tasks.objective: Implement deadline-aware continuous batching and autoscaling against measured service objectives.
acceptance: Throughput improvements cannot violate tail-latency, cancellation or quality budgets.

tasks.title: Load and capacity qualification
tasks.objective: Define canonical load profiles, saturation points, load shedding and capacity-plan evidence.
acceptance: Capacity exhaustion follows declared degradation policy instead of uncontrolled collapse.

tasks.title: Quota and budget accounting ledger
tasks.objective: Unify quota hierarchy with idempotent budget reservation, charge and reconciliation.
acceptance: Duplicate/retry paths cannot double-charge or bypass quota/authority constraints.

tasks.title: Forecasting and cost anomaly loop
tasks.objective: Backtest demand/capacity/cost forecasts and connect anomalies to accountable incident/workflow handling.
acceptance: Forecast accuracy and anomaly thresholds are measured, versioned and tied to operational action.

tasks.title: Aggregate exact-head P1 evidence
tasks.objective: Assemble exact-head lane receipts and maturity results into one terminal P1 evidence package.
acceptance: Every primary frontier volume is represented with required maturity evidence or explicit blocking status.

tasks.title: Terminal failure-journey qualification
tasks.objective: Run clean-machine, rollback, restore, saturation, partition, adversarial, provider-failover and stale-evidence journeys.
acceptance: All mandatory P1 failure families pass on the promotion head or block promotion.

tasks.title: Independent signed P1 promotion decision
tasks.objective: Independently verify all P1 evidence and record signed promotion or explicit rejection without self-certification.
acceptance: Promotion is exact-head, independently verified, signed, and leaves deferred 357-volume work visible.
